title: Locality and residue properties of purely inseparable tensor base change
statement: Let k and k' be fields with k' a finite purely inseparable extension of k [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], and (A,m,K) a Noetherian local commutative k-algebra, K=A/m [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Set d=dim_k k' and A'=A tensor_k k'. Then A' is local and there exists a maximal ideal m' that is the only prime containing mA'. There is a ring map f:K to A'/m' satisfying f(residue(a))=[a tensor 1], and A'/m' is finite as a K-module via f [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. There is a ring isomorphism e:A'/mA' to K tensor_k k' sending [a tensor x] to residue(a) tensor x. With its K-module structure induced by the ring map e inverse composed with the left-factor map K to K tensor_k k', the source of e has K-dimension d.

source.place: Proposition Tag 07E5, proof of (3) => (1); locality and finite flatness are used there without proof, expanded by the agent

proof.text: Use the tensor finite-module instance to make B = A tensor_k k' finite over A. By the finite-algebra local-radical lemma, every maximal ideal n of B contracts to m. Mathlib PrimeSpectrum.isHomeomorph_comap_of_isPurelyInseparable (Stacks Tag 0BRA) makes contraction injective on prime ideals. Therefore any two maximal ideals agree, so IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal proves locality. If a prime P contains mB, its contraction contains m and is proper, hence equals m; contraction injectivity then gives P = n. Conversely mB is contained in n by Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.

Define f : A/m to B/n by Ideal.Quotient.lift of the composite A to B to B/n, using mB <= n. Its value on residue classes is definitional. The quotient B/n is finite over A. The displayed residue-class formula gives IsScalarTower A (A/m) (B/n) by IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq. Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite A (A/m) (B/n) proves finiteness for precisely f.toAlgebra.

Use Mathlib Algebra.TensorProduct.quotientTensorEquiv directly: its inverse identifies B/mB with (A/m) tensor_k k', and quotientTensorEquiv_symm_apply_tmul proves the formula on pure tensors. Equip B/mB with the stipulated algebra structure e inverse composed with the left-factor map. The additive equivalence underlying e is K-linear: multiplicativity of e and e(e inverse(r)) = r prove the scalar formula. Its LinearEquiv.finrank_eq, followed by Module.finrank_baseChange (the rank-preserving base-change lemma), proves the required equality with finrank k k'.

lean.statement:
theorem purelyInseparable_baseChange_residue
    (k : Type u) (k' : Type v) (A : Type w)
    [Field k] [Field k'] [CommRing A] [Algebra k k'] [Algebra k A]
    [IsPurelyInseparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k']
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] :
    IsLocalRing (A ⊗[k] k') ∧
      (∃ m' : Ideal (A ⊗[k] k'),
        m'.IsMaximal ∧
        (∀ P : Ideal (A ⊗[k] k'), P.IsPrime →
          (Ideal.map (algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] k')) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ≤ P ↔ P = m')) ∧
        (∃ f : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A →+* ((A ⊗[k] k') ⧸ m'),
          (∀ a : A, f (IsLocalRing.residue A a) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk m' (algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] k') a)) ∧
          @Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ((A ⊗[k] k') ⧸ m')
            _ _ (@Algebra.toModule _ _ _ _ f.toAlgebra))) ∧
      (∃ e : ((A ⊗[k] k') ⧸
          (Ideal.map (algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] k')) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))) ≃+*
          ((IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ⊗[k] k'),
        (∀ (a : A) (x : k'), e (Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (Ideal.map (algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] k')) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))
          (a ⊗ₜ[k] x)) = (IsLocalRing.residue A a) ⊗ₜ[k] x) ∧
        @Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
          ((A ⊗[k] k') ⧸
            (Ideal.map (algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] k')) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)))
          _ _ (@Algebra.toModule _ _ _ _
            (e.symm.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
              ((IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ⊗[k] k'))).toAlgebra) =
            Module.finrank k k')
